emergingRockets.name: cbrock84/headcount
emergingRockets.description: An agent organization for Claude Code, structured as a company — 15+ departments, 125+ skills, each independently installable.

emergingRockets.name: rakanki911/DLSS5-Swapper
emergingRockets.description: DLSS 5 Swapper is a powerful, easy-to-use tool for installing, managing, and restoring DLSS 5 across games and supported emulators. It features automatic game detection, optional drive scanning, DLSS5-Feeder for compatible titles without native DLSS, emulator support, and compatibility with DirectX 9/10/11/12, Vulkan, and OpenGL.

emergingRockets.name: shadcn-ui/cn
emergingRockets.description: cn is a new engine for Tailwind class merging and conflict resolution. It replaces tailwind-merge and clsx. Same APIs. Full parity. And it is 30× faster.

emergingRockets.name: Player-YN/PawWork_ZhuaZhua
emergingRockets.description: Paw Work - selection-first web agent for Chrome: select on the live page, describe the outcome, take away an editable office file. BYOK, sandboxed, no server.

emergingRockets.name: 2akouwu/reverify
emergingRockets.description: AI makes things up when it reads a binary. Reverify checks its every claim against the real bytes, so you see what's actually true — AI-assisted reverse engineering you can trust. LLM proposes, deterministic tools verify. MCP server + CLI.

silentClimbers.name: chrisgreg/boop
silentClimbers.description: A tiny, self-hosted notification inbox for developers. Something happened in one of your apps; Boop tells you on your phone.

silentClimbers.name: jlrouzies-fr/DLSS5-Feeder
silentClimbers.description: DLSS 5 neural rendering in D3D11/D12/Vulkan games that ship without any DLSS — feeds a synthetic DLAA contract (ReShade depth + motion vectors) to the DLSS 5 add-on via a private D3D12 device.

silentClimbers.name: fanhao375/microduck-replica
